preconditions.description: The input must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in bird_names)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list.
The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(code, str) for code in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be a string.
Each code in the output list must be four characters long.
Each code in the output list must be in uppercase.

postconditions.expression: all(code == ''.join(part[:2].upper() for part in name.replace('-', ' ').split()[:4]) for name, code in zip(bird_names, return_value))
postconditions.description: Each code must be generated according to the specified rules from the corresponding bird name.
